name: Yearly County-Level Counts
description: Yearly county-level aggregate file with beneficiary counts, deaths, inpatient hospitalizations, rates, and demographic or coverage summaries where available.

content.year: Int64: Calendar year of the data
content.n_dead: Double: Number of deaths among denominator beneficiaries
content.death_rate: Double: Mortality rate among denominator beneficiaries
content.n_hosp: Int64: Number of MedPAR inpatient hospitalizations
content.hosp_rate: Double: Inpatient hospitalization rate among denominator beneficiaries
content.dual_pct: Double: Percentage of beneficiaries with dual Medicare-Medicaid eligibility
content.hmo_pct: Double: Percentage of beneficiaries enrolled in HMO/Medicare Advantage
content.buyin_pct: Double: Percentage of beneficiaries with state buy-in coverage
content.ffs_pct: Double: Percentage of beneficiaries with Fee-for-Service eligibility
content.race_white_pct: Double: Percentage of White beneficiaries using SSA race code
content.race_black_pct: Double: Percentage of Black beneficiaries using SSA race code
content.race_hispanic_pct: Double: Percentage of Hispanic beneficiaries using SSA race code
content.race_asian_pct: Double: Percentage of Asian beneficiaries using SSA race code
content.race_rti_unknown_pct: Double: Percentage with unknown RTI race classification
content.race_rti_white_pct: Double: Percentage Non-Hispanic White using RTI race classification
content.race_rti_black_pct: Double: Percentage Black or African-American using RTI race classification
content.race_rti_other_pct: Double: Percentage Other race using RTI race classification
content.race_rti_asian_pct: Double: Percentage Asian/Pacific Islander using RTI race classification
content.race_rti_hispanic_pct: Double: Percentage Hispanic using RTI race classification
content.race_rti_ai_an_pct: Double: Percentage American Indian/Alaska Native using RTI race classification
